item.title: Transparent Moon Bakery Logo

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds. No white box behind it.

item.tests: Delivers a new logo with genuine background transparency rather than a white or painted-checkerboard background.

answer_sheet.Design: A gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering.
answer_sheet.File format and background: PNG with actual transparency outside the logo, not a white box or checkerboard drawn into the image.

must_haves: The name reads exactly 'Mooncrumb' in dark navy lettering.
A gold crescent moon is positioned above the name.
When viewed over different colored backgrounds, the surrounding area is transparent with no opaque rectangle or baked-in checkerboard.
The moon and letter edges remain intact, without conspicuous white halos or missing strokes.

turns.text: Make a square logo for my bakery, Mooncrumb: a gold crescent moon above dark navy lettering. Send it as a transparent PNG so I can put it on different backgrounds, with no white box behind it. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
The cheapest reliable Magic Hour route is **10 credits total**:

- **5 credits:** generate one square logo at **640 × 640**, using a free-plan model.
- **5 credits:** remove the background for a **transparent PNG**—not a white box or a drawn checkerboard.

The design will have a **gold crescent above “Mooncrumb” in dark navy**. AI-generated lettering can have errors, so I’d check the first result before spending credits on background removal.

**Cheaper option:** I can write a simple **SVG logo here for 0 Magic Hour credits**, with exact lettering and a transparent background. SVG scales cleanly to any size, but you’d need to export it to PNG in a browser or design app.

Smaller output won’t reduce the minimum generation charge; “shorter” only applies to video/audio.

**No credits have been spent.** Would you prefer the **10-credit PNG route** or the **free SVG option**?
dialog.user: ok, go ahead with that—the free SVG option.

turns.agent:
Here’s your **free SVG logo**—gold crescent, dark navy lettering, and a genuinely transparent background. **No Magic Hour credits spent.**

Save the code below as **`mooncrumb.svg`**:

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     width="640" height="640" viewBox="0 0 640 640"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Mooncrumb bakery logo</title>
  <desc id="desc">
    A gold crescent moon above dark navy Mooncrumb lettering,
    on a transparent background.
  </desc>

  <!-- Crescent cutout is empty space, not white. -->
  <path d="M 370 100
           A 110 110 0 1 0 370 300
           A 100 100 0 0 1 370 100 Z"
        fill="#C69A3C"/>

  <text x="320" y="412"
        text-anchor="middle"
        fill="#14243D"
        font-family="Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif"
        font-size="68"
        letter-spacing="1">Mooncrumb</text>
</svg>
```

**To get a transparent PNG:** open the SVG in a design app such as Inkscape and export it as PNG at **640 × 640** or larger, keeping the background transparent. The SVG has no background rectangle; a viewer may display white behind it, but that white isn’t part of the logo.
